title: Mang Den plateau day
summary: Dak Ke lake in the morning and Kon Pring in the afternoon. Pa Sy and the church stay dossier-only until a licensed photo exists.

stops.name: Dak Ke Lake
stops.note: Shore walk while the air is still cool. Gate fees stay check on arrival.

stops.name: Kon Pring village
stops.note: Communal house and gong culture on Highway 24. Ask before photos inside the rong house.

seoTitle: One day on the Mang Den plateau
seoDescription: Dak Ke lake and Kon Pring village from a Mang Den base, on the only sights with licensed photos today.
